description_en: Queries the services integrated with CloudConfig and their statuses
description_zh: 查询配置审计集成的服务列表及其状态
name: ListIntegratedService

Data.description_en: The information about the integrated services

items.description_en: The information about the integrated services

AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_en:
The event type for cross-account integration. Supported event types:

NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance events
AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_zh:
跨账号集成的事件类型。支持的事件类型有：
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件

IntegratedTypes.description_en:
The event types for the integration. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Supported event types:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: resource change events.

NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance events
IntegratedTypes.description_zh:
集成的事件类型，多个事件类型用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持的事件类型有：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：资源变更事件。
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件

ServiceCode.description_en:
The identifier of the integrable Alibaba Cloud service. Valid values:

eventbridge: EventBridge.

cms: Cloud Monitor.

bpstudio: Cloud Architect Design Tools
ServiceCode.description_zh:
可集成云服务标识。取值：

eventbridge：事件总线。

cms：云监控。

bpstudio：云速搭

ServiceName.description_en: The name of the integrated service

Status.description_en:
The integration status of the Alibaba Cloud service. Valid values:

true: The service is integrated.

false: The service is not integrated
Status.description_zh:
云服务的集成状态。取值：

true：已集成。

false：未集成
